■Stage Direction
Looking restless.

■Stage Direction
Age: 20s
Personality: Serious

No. I didn't expect it to be such a sophisticated place...
So I feel a bit out of place.
Ah... um, what was it called again...

Even though I checked the map and took the right train,
I just couldn't find it.
The others... Now that you mention it, that could be good too.

I see, that is good then.
Still... I can't help feeling restless.

Incredible... Golden cream... Is that sea urchin?
Glittering atop the pasta... It's like a jewel...
Oguri Cap is staring intently at a magazine...
It was a blissful time, almost like living in a dream.

Oh... It doesn't have to be the official name?
...Alright.

Yeah. It's a shop known for its pasta and pancakes.
Apparently, people call it a "hidden gem."

Trying what someone else likes instead of just sticking to
my own favorites is surprisingly enjoyable, isn't it?

Heh, I'm glad to hear that.
Today has really been a great day.

Amazing... Did you see that, Trainer?
Even I managed to place the order properly.

Ah...
Could it be that it's operating under a disguised identity...?

Trainer, what do you think about ordering
every single item written on the menu?

The pasta and pancakes tasted wonderful, so I'm sure
the other dishes are just as delicious.

It sounded like French... with katakana words...
One was a sea urchin pasta, but what was it called...
...! Really? May I?

If I'm with you, Trainer, I have nothing to worry about.
I'll gladly take you up on that offer. Thank you.

Yes, since we're here, let's try that.
Please let me order it.

Excuse me, we would also like two pancakes
topped with plenty of fruit, please.

Are these clothes alright? In the city, aren't there
places that turn you away if you don't follow their dress code?

In that case, what would be the right thing to order...
Mmm, this is a difficult choice.
Have you decided on your order?

Truth is, I was looking for a place to visit on my next day off,
but there are so many shops compared to back home... that it took a while.

I usually only visit places near the academy,
but today, Trainer said they would guide me around.
I've picked out a few other spots as well.

I see. Fruit sauce on a hamburg steak didn't quite
make sense to me at first, but this is definitely good.

It vanished so quickly that
I feel like I haven't savored it enough. Since we came all this way—

Ah, and this one... Warm pancakes with cold ice cream...
So much fresh fruit... What luxury...
In that case, that would be our Lumière Dorée Sea Urchin Cream Pasta.
Hm? ...That works too, I suppose.

However... the other day, I saw an advertisement for a ramen shop
just like that and headed out, but...

...We can't? In that case, could you choose the order?
Which dish would you prefer?

Looks like today will be a full day of café hopping.
I'm looking forward to it, Trainer.

Mmm... Then why couldn't I find it?
How strange.
Yes. But the names are difficult...

Looking at the maps in the magazine, they're so simplified
that it's hard to tell where anything is. Going alone would be worrying for Oguri Cap...

Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you, my culinary horizons have broadened.
Oh, Trainer.
After Oguri Cap spent dozens of minutes having a stare-down with the menu—

...Trainer.
I have a suggestion: what if we order seconds?

Certainly, the Fruits Crêpe, was it?
Right away~
Hmm... That's a dish I've never heard of.

It certainly lives up to being "hidden."
...Finding it is no simple task.

We might miss lunchtime, but
judging by my stomach, I could easily visit ten more places.
Well then, shall we head to the next shop?

Oguri Cap raised her hand happily like a child to call the server,
and ordered, "The pie thing with the hamburg steak."

...It's no use, I can't decide!
Everything looks so delicious, I want to order it all!

Crisp, flaky pastry with a berry sauce that has just the right mix of tartness and sweetness,
and inside the crust, a juicy, succulent hamburg steak—

Oguri Cap had seemed nervous in the unfamiliar setting,
but after eating, all her tension completely melted away—

It was delicious... A flavor I've never experienced before.
It melted in my mouth and vanished in an instant...

On our next day off. After a lengthy train ride,
we arrived at the café Oguri Cap had wanted to visit.

Trainer, thank you for today.
The food was delicious, and it was lots of fun.

So this is the place... We didn't get lost at all.
As expected of you, Trainer.

With Oguri Cap walking with a visibly brisker stride,
we continued our café tour right up until the dormitory curfew...
